## What changes?

Describe the behavior before and after this change and the engineering reason.

## Evidence

Include the commands actually run and their results. For native changes, include
Xcode/Simulator versions and the affected baseline/broken/fixed comparison.
Link only reviewed, exported artifacts; never attach raw test plans or credentials.

## Scope and limitations

State what the evidence establishes and what remains untested. Keep driver
observations separate from fixture evidence, and do not relabel expected failures.
